name: io.github.p-bean-labs/percival-agentmail-mcp
title: Percival AgentMail MCP
description: MCP server for managing an AgentMail inbox through tools and prompts.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMAIL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AgentMail API credential; use the *_FILE form for read-only mounted secrets.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMAIL_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path inside the runtime to a read-only file containing the AgentMail API credential.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMAIL_INBOX_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default inbox identifier; treat as a secret and prefer the *_FILE form.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMAIL_INBOX_ID_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path inside the runtime to a read-only file containing the default inbox identifier.
